meta.note: std_curve(): per-landmark multi-state Cox (12-month window, cause-specific hazards for cancer and other death), predicted cancer-death probability averaged over the cohort's own covariate distribution (direct standardization). Plateau end = broken-stick hinge on landmarks 0-18 (grid 0-15 by 0.25).

definitions.surgery: lm.surgery(): no = s1 '00' or s2 'A000'; unknown = 99/98/A990/A980/blank; else yes (no unknowns in distant NEC)
definitions.liver: mets_liver Yes vs No among 2010+ diagnoses (Blank pre-2010 and Unknown/NA excluded, n=4 excluded)
definitions.liver_only: mets_liver Yes and mets_bone/brain/lung all 'No' (n=389); 'other patterns' (n=302) = liver No (n=132), or liver Yes with any of bone/brain/lung Yes (n=157) or Unknown-only (n=13); sensitivity excludes the 13 Unknown-only cases
definitions.conditional_on_3mo: patients still at risk at landmark 3 (half-day index >= floor(2*MD*3)+1); bootstrap resamples drawn within this subset
definitions.plateau: broken-stick hinge on landmark 0-18 point estimates, grid 0-15 by 0.25; CI = percentile of hinge over bootstrap curves; bootstrap curves with NaN at late landmarks (0 at risk in that resample) have the NaN filled with that curve's own mean before the hinge fit (revision: previously the global mean)
definitions.time_dependent_chemo: tt_days (days from diagnosis to first-course treatment) defines the exposure start for chemotherapy-recorded patients (unknown tt imputed at the median of known chemo-yes tt in the same cohort; tt later than the survival end date clipped to it); chemo-no patients are never exposed. Primary cohort = no primary-site surgery and no radiotherapy (first treatment = chemotherapy); secondary = full cohort. Landmark classification: at landmark s, 'initiated' = exposure start <= s among patients at risk at s. Rates: person-time in each interval split at the exposure start; deaths assigned to the exposure state at death. Rate-ratio CIs are Poisson (log-scale, 1/d1+1/d2).
